== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[BoShek, Brash Smuggler (Errata 2)]], showing the '''PC-E2''' game text (the PC website card list). No published image shows this text. Other versions: [[BoShek, Brash Smuggler]] (original), [[BoShek, Brash Smuggler (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[BoShek, Brash Smuggler (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3) and [[BoShek, Brash Smuggler (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, the current text).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting a freighter at a battleground system, adds 1 to attrition against opponent here and their starships here may not 'cloak.' Opponent loses no more than 3 Force to your Force drains at same system.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number, copyright line) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-63-BoShek_Brash_Smuggler-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B09 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
* '''Renamed:''' 11 November 2026 from <code>VB6-63-BoShek_Brash_Smuggler-PC-E1-cardmaker.png</code>: the versions were put in date order (Batch S1, versions ruling of 11 November 2026). The image itself is unchanged.
